configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native (dev box / build on the Pi)

configurePresets.name: arm64
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for aarch64 against this container's libraries (compile test)
configurePresets.description: Checks that the code cross-compiles and lints without needing a Pi. libduet_sbc.so from this preset links the container's glibc (2.39) and will NOT load on Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm - use pi-arm64 for anything you intend to run there.

configurePresets.name: pi-arm64
configurePresets.displayName: Cross-compile for aarch64 against a Pi sysroot (deployable)
configurePresets.description: Links against a sysroot copied from the target, so libduet_sbc.so matches the Pi's glibc. Requires pi-sysroot/ to exist: fetch it with Scripts/fetch-pi-sysroot.sh <user>@<pi-host>, or override the path with -DDUET_SBC_SYSROOT=...
